sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India has been filed with a prayer to stay the effect and operation of the order dated 21.08.2023 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Meerut and order dated 01.03.2025 passed by Additional Session Judge/Special Judge, E.C. Act, Meerut and to stay the proceeding of the case no.11968 of 2021,
pending in the Court of Additional Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Meerut under section 498A, 364 IPC, P.S. Jani, District Meerut.
From the perusal of the material on record and looking into the facts of the case, at this stage it cannot be said that no offence is made out against the petitioners.
Accordingly, prayer of the applicants is refused.

sentences.text: However, in view of the submissions, it is provided that in case the petitioners move an application for discharge through counsel within three weeks, the same shall be disposed of by the trial court by a reasoned and speaking order in accordance with law within two weeks thereafter.
Till the disposal of the discharge application, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioners.

With the aforesaid direction, this application is disposed of Order Date :- 4.4.2025 Monika  Bhagwat Singh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118634274/
